hooks.name: Set up this checkout
hooks.description: Install pinned dependencies, generate harness configuration, and load the development tools when a session starts.

hooks.name: Check shell commands before running
hooks.description: Block overly broad output, misleading commands, and unsafe staging; explain how to correct the command.

hooks.name: Remind agents about shell conventions
hooks.description: Add non-blocking reminders about working-directory changes, environment prefixes, and preserving command exit status.

hooks.name: Record subagent requests locally
hooks.description: Save delegation requests in this checkout's local logs to review model routing and cost.

hooks.name: Record subagent starts locally
hooks.description: Save subagent start events in this checkout's local delegation logs.

hooks.name: Give subagents repository instructions
hooks.description: Provide each subagent with the repository's working-directory, search, file ownership, and reporting rules.

hooks.name: Record subagent completions locally
hooks.description: Save subagent completion events in this checkout's local delegation logs.
